description: Confirmed screenshot hosts: the developer's own hosting for an app whose upstream host is elsewhere (the validate.py advisory 'screenshot host is not the app's upstream host - confirm it is the developer's own hosting'). A host here has been reviewed like a source_policy.json rule: the decision is recorded, dated and referenced, and validate.py no longer warns about it. Adding a host is a reviewed decision, not an escape hatch - everything not listed still warns.

repo.ikghd.me.reason: iKarwan's own depiction server for his killerplus-family tweaks; the YTKillerPlus / InkilkerPlus / TTKillerPlus screenshots live in its /depictions/me.ikghd.ytkplus/ tree, published from his tweak repositories.

apps.sidestore.io.reason: SideStore's own project domain; the SideStore screenshots are published there by the project, which ships its source from github.com/julionc/SideStore.

aidoku.app.reason: Aidoku's own project site; the Aidoku screenshots are published on the project's domain, which ships its source from github.com/Aidoku/Aidoku.
